channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: North Korea deploys 400-strong drone unit to aid Putin — Report
item.description: Ukrainian Defence Intelligence said that there are already 8,500 North Korean soldiers stationed in Russia.

item.title: New Indian phones in 10-14 months? 5 things to know about the government’s smartphone push
item.description: Apple may expand its manufacturing footprint in India beyond iPhones, Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said, as the government pushes a new scheme aimed at strengthening domestic mobile production and building Indian smartphone brands.

item.title: Trump tariff threat pushes US, Canada towards trade deal as talks enter final stretch
item.description: The US and Canada are racing to finalise a trade deal before President Donald Trump's threatened 50% tariff on about $20 billion of Canadian goods takes effect Saturday. Negotiators say talks are very close, but key issues remain.

item.title: India moving from 'prohibited' to 'permitted' model to boost growth; world sees it as bright spot: PM Modi
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi said India is moving from a prohibited unless permitted to a permitted unless prohibited regulatory model. He said reforms, policy continuity and political stability are helping India emerge as a global bright spot for growth and hope.

item.title: Nadda reviews H1N1 readiness as Delhi cases rise
item.description: Delhi has recorded 1,449 H1N1 infections by mid-August, compared with 229 during the corresponding period last year.

item.title: Only 223 urban local bodies have ratings, limiting access to municipal credit
item.description: Only 223 of India's 4,332 urban local bodies have credit ratings, blocking access to a ₹5.8 trillion financing opportunity even as cities face an ₹11.5 trillion capex need through FY31.&nbsp;

item.title: Govt plans new scheme to support domestic manufacturing of polysilicon
item.description: Polysilicon is used to make ingots, which are then processed into wafers and used to produce solar cells.

item.title: US green card applicants alert: New Form I-485 takes effect from September 18 — All you need to know about it
item.description: USCIS will introduce a revised Form I-485 for green card applications next month, rejecting older versions postmarked after September 18.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘Victory for journalism’: Prince Harry ordered to pay £9.54 million as Daily Mail lawsuit fails
item.description: BRITAIN-ROYALS-HARRY:Prince Harry and others ordered to pay millions over failed lawsuit

item.title: Delhi swine flu: Over 1,700 cases logged this year amid surge in seasonal influenza infections
item.description: The health minister said the government is closely monitoring the situation and has directed all government hospitals to ensure adequate treatment facilities are available.

item.title: Why are sugar prices rising? Centre rejects ethanol link, cites five reasons behind surge
item.description: Sugar prices have risen to ₹55.70/kg from ₹48.18/kg in a month. The Centre rejects linking the surge to ethanol production, citing lower output, festive demand, crop damage, tighter global supplies, and speculation or hoarding as key reasons.

item.title: Delhi Police registers FIR over alleged pellet gun use during CJP protest after Rahul Gandhi’s sit-in
item.description: The Delhi Police on Friday registered an FIR following a complaint about the alleged use of pellet guns during the 20 July CJP protests. Rahul Gandhi visited the Parliament Street police station and staged a sit-in, which ended after the FIR was filed.

item.title: CDSCO orders action against unapproved enclomiphene drugs
item.description: State authorities must immediately trace manufacturers, marketers, distributors, and retailers dealing in unapproved enclomiphene products, initiate regulatory action, and ensure these items are not manufactured or sold within their jurisdictions.

item.title: IMD forecasts widespread rain across central, northeast India; monsoon activity to stay subdued over peninsular region
item.description: A low-pressure area over Madhya Pradesh is likely to bring heavy to very heavy rain to east Madhya Pradesh, while the northeast faces a flash-flood risk over the next 24 hours.

item.title: Turkey issues arrest warrant for Israel's Netanyahu
item.description: Turkey has already issued warrants against Netanyahu and other top officials for ‘genocide’ over Israel's actions in the Gaza war.

item.title: Kolkata girl complains about ringing sound in ear, undergoes emergency surgery after MRI reveals something else
item.description: A young patient from Kolkata underwent surgery after months of living with a persistent ringing noise in one of her ears. An MRI venogram revealed something no doctor could predict initially.

item.title: Weather update: Delhi sees coldest July day in 3 years amid severe waterlogging; flood alert in Odisha
item.description: In Delhi, heavy downpours on Tuesday triggered widespread waterlogging and severe traffic gridlocks across several neighbourhoods.

item.title: China vs Pakistan: Former Army chief Gen Naravane explains India's two very different security challenges
item.description: Naravane has said that Pakistan and China present totally different challenges. “We have fought wars with both of them. We have unsettled borders,” he noted.

item.title: ‘Peak Bengaluru moment’: Software engineer gets job offer from AI startup while flat hunting; social media reacts
item.description: A viral X post highlights a user's flat-hunting adventure in Bengaluru, where he inadvertently met the founders of a legal AI startup.&nbsp;

item.title: Supreme Court cuts mandatory legal practice for civil judge aspirants from 3 years to 1: What it said
item.description: The Supreme Court revised its May 2025 ruling, reducing the mandatory legal practice for entry-level judicial exams from three years to one. Candidates must complete training at a judicial academy and an additional one-year clerkship under the revised framework.

item.title: Quote of the day by Walt Disney: ‘All our dreams can come true, if we have the courage to pursue them'
item.description: Dreams may be common, but the courage to pursue them is rare. The true difference between success and failure lies in the willingness to take risks, accept potential failure, and act despite fears. Ambition alone cannot guarantee outcomes.

item.title: CJP team ‘beaten up’ on way to ‘expose buffalo-shed school’ in Jaipur, Dipke slams Rajasthan Police, BJP: VIDEOS
item.description: The incident took place when CJP co-convenor, Ashutosh Ranka, accompanied by a CJP team, visited a government school in Rampura Kanwarpura village in Jaipur, Rajasthan, which he claimed had been operating in a buffalo shed for the past several years.

item.title: Margaret Qualley leaves internet in disbelief with barefoot sandals in London; where to buy them, cost and more
item.description: Margaret Qualley's viral shoes comeswith only a little leather straps attached to a heel cap. Her fashion moment from the The Dog Stars premiere in London has sparked a debate on the internet.

item.title: Quote of the day by Hannah Arendt: ‘The most radical revolutionary will become a conservative the day after the…'
item.description: Hannah Arendt's words highlight the tendency of rebels to become conservative once they achieve power. This shift from radical opposition to cautious defence illustrates that the burden of responsibility can transform a leader's priorities and actions.

item.title: Eight dead as chartered plane crashes in Alaska; NTSB, FAA to investigate cause
item.description: Two pilots and six passengers were on board the aircraft, which was a civilian-contracted flight.

item.title: Who is Min Zin? US citizen ‘wrongfully detained’ in China on espionage charges; here's what we know
item.description: The US has designated Myanmar-born American scholar U Min Zin as wrongfully detained in China, making his release a priority. Min Zin was detained in June while attending an academic conference in Yunnan and faces Chinese espionage allegations.

item.title: Did Meghan Markle seek Kamala Harris' Senate seat after exit from Royal duties with Harry? New claims surface
item.description: New claims suggest that Meghan Markle and Prince Harry might have tried hard to get into US politics with no success so far. From sending lemons to Jill Biden to anti-Trump comment, several allegations arrived amid the couple's upcoming move to the UK.

item.title: Taylor Swift's ex-beau Conor Kennedy on Russia's wanted list — Know charges against US Health Secretary RFK Jr's son
item.description: Taylor Swift's ex-boyfriend Conor Kennedy is on Russia's international wanted list. Here's all you need to know &nbsp;about charges against US Health Secretary RFK Jr's son.

item.title: At least 22 Indian nationals aboard two commercial vessels hijacked by pirates in Yemen, Somalia: What we know
item.description: Two commercial vessels carrying 22 Indian nationals were hijacked in separate incidents off Yemen and Somalia. While all 20 crew members aboard the M.T. Sibu 1 were reported safe, six Indians were among 10 crew members aboard the M/V LUTUF hijacked off Somalia.

item.title: Iran war enters ‘new phase’: JD Vance calls US economic pressure a ‘delicate dance’ as tensions escalate
item.description: Speaking on the ‘Clay Travis and Buck Sexton Show,’ Vance said the US could use economic measures to influence Tehran but warned that such pressure could also have wider consequences.

item.title: Who is Jessica Bowie? 35-year-old Albany woman arrested for plotting to bomb the New York State Capitol, kill senators
item.description: A 35-year-old Albany woman, Jessica Bowie, was arrested for allegedly plotting to bomb the New York State Capitol and kill senators in an ISIS-inspired attack. She was caught in an FBI sting operation and faces charges of providing material support to ISIS.

item.title: More than 50 dead, mostly children, as overloaded boat capsizes in Nigeria's Sokoto
item.description: The witness saw 50 bodies, many wrapped in mats and traditional cloths, lying in the forecourt of a community mosque ahead of their burial in Gorau later on Thursday.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today: How costly is fuel in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru as crude oil declines after 5-day rally?
item.description: Petrol and diesel prices today — 21 Aug: Crude prices declined on 21 August amid escalating tensions in West Asia, particularly after Trump's ‘economic warfare’ threat for Iran. Check fuel rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru and other cities here.

item.title: English a foreign or indigenous language? Supreme Court asks during CBSE's 3-language rule hearing
item.description: A Bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana noted that the status of English in India may require constitutional examination given its historical roots and use as an official language by several States

item.title: Switzerland, China agree on a trade deal giving 99.8% of Swiss exports duty-free access to Beijing
item.description: China and Switzerland have concluded negotiations on an updated trade agreement that will give 99.8% of Swiss exports duty-free access to China. The deal also expands market access for Swiss investors and strengthens cooperation on labour, environmental and trade issues.
